[AUTOMATIC 20-MINUTE WORKING-STATUS CHECK]
You previously reported that you were working, but Orgtree has not woken you for 20 minutes. Check the actual work, files, processes, and messages. If useful work remains, make concrete progress now. Do not claim that work is continuing without verifying it.
